propositions: Link-sync tests exercise only a single representative relation (blocks ~19×, depends_on 0×) instead of the full relation vocabulary, creating blind spots that allowed bug c8ed to ship
Three sibling test gaps exist in the link-sync seam, all following the same pattern of incomplete coverage over relation types
test_link_dedup.py must parametrize outbound _diff_links emission over all 6 relations, asserting (jira_type, swap) tuple for mapped relations and empty list for unmapped relations
test_link_removal_sync.py must add an untested REMOVE case where an outward Blocks link is removed, asserting the emitted mutation contains relation: depends_on with correct swap orientation
New parametrized tests must assert per-relation ORIENTATION (swap direction) explicitly, so a regression in the swap logic would cause test failure
